projects.name: IDOT Multi-Year Improvement Program - Roadway FY 2027-2031
projects.notes: IDOT's published FY 2026-2031 Multi-Year Program (Publicatio = '20262031MULTI-YEAR SQ'), hosted on IDOT's ArcGIS Online account despite the service name 'MYP_Test'. All planned. Layers: 0 Structure FY 2026 (point, 953), 1 Structure FY 2027-2031 (point, 1682), 2 Spot FY 2026 (point, 425), 3 Spot FY 2027-2031 (point, 1093), 4 Roadway FY 2026 (polyline, 660), 5 Roadway FY 2027-2031 (polyline, 1734). The FY 2026 layers are the current annual program (soonest to construction). No letting date: ProgramYea is the year within the program (2-6 here). Improvem_1..Improve_11 hold up to 11 improvement types; ProjectTam is the asset-management category; EstimatedC is text with commas. County1..County4.

projects.name: IDOT Annual Highway Improvement Program FY 2026 - Land Acquisition
projects.notes: Checked 2026-11-21. IDOT's own ArcGIS Online account (IDOTAdmin), item 32034a6a70dc4dc7beeebfea9fc1c2a4, data last edited 2026-10-02. The item says it is 'a detailed account of the Fiscal Year 2026 highway program element, originally presented in the Fiscal Year 2026-2031 Proposed Highway Improvement Program'. Layer 3 holds only the 61 projects (RecordType 'LA') for which IDOT has programmed money to BUY LAND this fiscal year: every row has Improvem_1 = 'Land Acquisition', so each is a direct sign of right-of-way purchase, earlier and plainer than the construction rows. PPSProject is the same project number used in the Multi-Year Program layers, so rows join to those. ProjectTam is the asset-management category, not a phase (mapped to status for want of one). EstimatedC is text with commas ('100,000') and is the land budget, not the construction cost. Location is free text (e.g. '0.5 MI S of 2275 E RD to 1 MI S of Dameron RD ...'). No county field and no date. Other layers of the service: 0 Bridge Improvement (421), 1 Engineering (2,082, 64 of them also naming land acquisition in Improvem_1..3), 2 Construction (967). The same four layers are on IDOT's own server at https://gis1.dot.illinois.gov/arcgis/rest/services/GAI/ANN/MapServer (61 rows in layer 3 as well). Terms: the item's licenseInfo and credit are empty; no limit on use is stated. maxRecordCount 2000.

summary: Projects: IDOT Multi-Year Program FY 2026-2031 verified as six ArcGIS Online layers (roadway lines, structure and spot points) with improvement type and cost but no letting date. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; DuPage and Lake verified with taxpayer names; Cook, Will and Kane have no usable owner layer. Added 2026-11-18: Morgan verified with disclaimer-only terms; Madison, McHenry, Peoria, Tazewell, Whiteside and Adams verified with owner and mailing address but no readable terms. Cook, Will, Winnebago, St. Clair, Champaign, Sangamon and Kendall: no public owner layer found (Cook and Will servers refused or timed out; Kane's public layer has no owner field). Added 2026-11-21: the FY 2026 Annual Program's Land Acquisition layer (61 projects IDOT is buying land for this year).
